## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes (gofmt, vet, tests)
- [ ] `golangci-lint run ./...` passes
- [ ] New behaviour has tests; golden files updated if output changed intentionally
- [ ] README / CHANGELOG updated where user-visible behaviour changed
- [ ] No environment variable values, tokens or credentials appear in output, tests or fixtures
